snippet.title: Peak Rhythm | Early Access Launch Trailer | Meta Quest Platform
snippet.description:
LOCK IN. The climb starts now on Meta Quest: https://www.meta.com/experiences/peak-rhythm/7639650372802770

🧤 Climb to the beat, miss and you drop
🎵 Original electronic soundtrack
📈 Leaderboards with height scoring
🛠️ Beatmap Editor

Join our community Discord → https://discord.gg/RZuzxpRcyV

FOLLOW OUR SOCIALS:
X → https://x.com/PeakRhythmVR
Instagram → https://www.instagram.com/peakrhythmvr
TikTok → https://www.tiktok.com/@peakrhythmvr
Facebook → https://www.facebook.com/PeakRhythmVR/
YouTube → https://www.youtube.com/@ImpactInked


ABOUT PEAK RHYTHM:
Peak Rhythm is a VR rhythm-climbing game where music drives momentum. Every grab and twist powers your robotic platform upward through a neon-soaked city.
Sync your moves to a high-octane electronic soundtrack to master the flow and dominate global leaderboards. Blending physical precision with Cyberpunk aesthetics and Y2K energy, your rhythm is your engine.


#MetaQuest #VR #PeakRhythm #RhythmGame
